segments.spoken: Cadence reports up to five times greater token efficiency for its specialized chip-design AI, compared with a general-purpose foundation model. This is an early vendor result, not your savings.
Here is the number executives should test. Total workflow cost divided by accepted outputs, not price per AI call.

In a fictional one thousand task pilot, option A costs ten cents per run. With review and rework, seven hundred pass. Total cost is three hundred ninety dollars, or fifty six cents per accepted result.
Option B costs twenty five cents per run. Nine hundred pass. After review and rework, total cost is four hundred thirty dollars, or forty eight cents per accepted result.
The higher priced model wins this hypothetical comparison. Cheaper inference does not always mean a cheaper business workflow.
In your pilot, include model costs, human review, rework, infrastructure, security and quality. True return on investment also needs the value delivered.
Test before signing. Prism Bay AI helps founders and executives measure practical AI business systems.

sourceClaimScope: Initial semiconductor design workflow results, not independently verified customer financial ROI. Cadence reports up to 5X token efficiency, not up to 5X overall business cost savings.
